limits: Actual phone Wi-Fi path not tested.

No source mutation was performed by reviewer. HMR proof is author-run evidence inspected against unchanged final source hashes.

WebKit mouse closure after typing in Research moves DOM focus to body while logical focused child persists. The identical behavior was reproduced in standalone archive, dev and build. Keyboard last-close recovery and explicit reopen focus pass; this is an unchanged browser-focus limit, not an actionable Astro migration regression.
